text:
I'm not sure I understand this talk about "cancelling the application".
You do want to pursue the partner visa, right? So why would you cancel an application that you already have open and ongoing?

If you get a far interview date you can go abroad and wait there for a while, but the application is not cancelled. You will have to come back eventually with an invitation. 
Also, if you tell them you plan on leaving they will probably not give you an interview date at all. Interviews are only scheduled for people who are in Israel.

As a non-married couple, in every scenario there will be a waiting period in Israel without being able to work.
